item.title: Monaco to host first-ever energy storage forum to position principality as innovation hub
item.description: It marks the principality's bid to establish itself as a strategic European hub for clean energy technology and grid innovation.

item.title: Monaco Polar Symposium aims to transform polar science into solutions
item.description: Hundreds of polar researchers will descend on Monaco next month as the principality hosts the third Monaco Polar Symposium, an event increasingly focused on moving beyond data collection to practical solutions.

item.title: Monaco’s hot air balloon team sets sight on Alpine tour and Channel crossing
item.description: The Monaco Ballooning Team has announced an ambitious programme for 2026, including participation in a record-breaking attempt to cross the English Channel with 200 balloons.

item.title: Monaco and Japan to celebrate 20 years of friendship
item.description: Two decades after establishing diplomatic ties on 14 December 2006, Monaco and Japan are celebrating their friendship with a year of cultural events taking place in both nations.

item.title: Trump backs down on Greenland tariffs after NATO “framework agreement”
item.description: US President Donald Trump abruptly reversed course on Wednesday, scrapping threatened tariffs against European nations after announcing a "framework" deal with NATO over Arctic security.

item.title: Prince Albert and Princess Charlene open new indoor playground in Monaco
item.description: Prince Albert II and Princess Charlene inaugurated 'Little Wonders', Monaco's new indoor playground for young children, on Thursday morning.

item.title: Italian mayors of historic Grimaldi sites gather at Monaco Embassy in Rome
item.description: Mayors from 46 Italian municipalities gathered at Monaco's Rome embassy last week to discuss plans for strengthening ties to their shared Grimaldi heritage.

item.title: Monaco police report moderate crime levels at annual New Year ceremony
item.description: Prince Albert II presided over the annual New Year ceremony of Monaco's Public Safety Department on Wednesday, where Director Eric Arella reviewed 2025's security performance and presented a generally positive assessment.

item.title: Monaco students dive into coral conservation with new AMPN and CSM partnership
item.description: “Each concrete experience sparks curiosity and shapes their desire to protect the environment.”

item.title: Monte Carlo Rally gets underway with spectacular official kick-off
item.description: The 94th Monte Carlo departed from Monaco's Port Hercule on Thursday, with 66 crews heading into the Alps to face what competitors are calling exceptionally challenging conditions.
